messages.content: Hey, weekly check-in from Northline Care. Hope things are going alright out there. Got a blood pressure reading handy to share?
Thanks, got that logged — 142/86. Appreciate you keeping up with it. Anything else you want to pass along, or are we good for today?
That's all I've got. Same time next week?
Yep, I'll reach out same time next week. You'll get the usual reminder the morning of. Take care.
